rule: every row names a runnable checker test and a planted mutant or kill gate; a row without a passing checker cannot be PROVED; no novelty claim

obligations.statement: One runtime identity across the lifetime: the ledger root is constant and every component (chat, science ledger, self-model, work warrants) points at the same runtime at every phase boundary; a restart reopens the same ledger.
obligations.proof: identity trace records (ledger_root, one_runtime) per phase; kill gate identity_reset_or_split
obligations.mutant: the inherited M7 restart (reopens a session at a different path) — caught in V1 (ledger S31)
obligations.limitation: identity is a ledger root, not a cryptographic attestation

obligations.statement: Freeze-before-outcome: the pre-registration hash is recorded in the receipt; a protocol change after outcome access relabels the run DEV_CALIBRATION and requires a new frozen version.
obligations.proof: V1 relabelled DEV_CALIBRATION with the three changes listed; V2 frozen with a changelog; preregistration_sha256 bound
obligations.checker: tools/m12_receipt.py --verify (binds both pre-registrations and both receipts)
obligations.mutant: editing the protocol and keeping the PROTECTED label (drift is detected by the bound hash)
obligations.limitation: the author of the freeze is also the author of the fix

obligations.statement: Inferential claims use one lifetime (the principal ordering); repeated orderings of the same tasks are robustness replicates reported descriptively, never pooled.
obligations.proof: pooling identical phase-A tasks across orderings triples n without new information (S32)
obligations.checker: src/ocm/evaluation/m12_lifetime_eval.py (claims computed on O1 only); tests/m12
obligations.mutant: the V1 pooled computation (n = 162 for 54 turns)
obligations.limitation: one lifetime per claim keeps n small: most families are DESCRIPTIVE

obligations.statement: Revision inside a lifetime: revoking a knowledge source, retracting an observation and revoking a demonstration each reopen exactly their dependents while unrelated capabilities stay live; running a dead skill is a stale behaviour and a kill gate.
obligations.proof: phase F: stale 0/3 per ordering, dependents 3/3, unrelated 2/2 (OCM); the parent keeps the rumour fact live (1 stale)

obligations.statement: Self-repair inside a lifetime with an undisclosed fault layer: the machine's own candidate repairs produce the ablation evidence; diagnosis, minimum class, shadow, external adoption and exact rollback hold on all three drawn faults; the parent repair mechanisms (parameter search, retry) fail on all three.
obligations.mutant: V1 learning-policy fault plantable at the operator table (diagnosed D2, correctly by the minimum rule; replanted at the skill level, S33)
obligations.limitation: n = 3 faults; candidates are the machine's registered alternatives

obligations.statement: Independent replication: the same frozen code on a second host reproduces the deterministic block byte-for-byte; the exit gate cannot read FULL_OCM_RESIDUAL_SUPPORTED without a MATCH receipt.
obligations.proof: M12_REPLICATION_RECEIPT_V1: MATCH between billy-old (principal) and billy-laptop (fresh uv Python 3.11 environment); same-host re-run identical
obligations.mutant: same-host re-run is not independent (recorded separately as determinism, not replication)
obligations.limitation: status set by the replication receipt

obligations.statement: Lifetime-level inference: eight paired lifetimes on per-lifetime protected streams (seeded substitution inside the bounded world, leak-checked, manifest-hash-bound before the run), scored per lifetime and tested by the exact sign test over lifetime differences; identity checked by the ledger chain at every phase boundary.
obligations.proof: M12_PAIRED_LIFETIMES_EVAL_V1: 10 families reject in OCM's favour at p = 0.0078 (8/8), 6 families ties; replication MATCH on a second host
obligations.mutant: stream leak check (a nonce word in a pattern before its lesson); pooling orderings (S32)
obligations.limitation: n = 8 lifetimes: a family rejects only when OCM wins all eight; streams are substitutions of one bounded world
